lines.zh: 我这只最少见，一个也难遇。
lines.en: The rarest of us. You'd seldom meet one.
I move fast. Hunger.
Four thin legs. Quick enough.
I slip in from the edge of the dead land.

lines.zh: 我贴着地走，几乎不抬头。
lines.en: Low to the ground. Head barely up.

lines.zh: 身上的皮松了，走一步晃一下。
lines.en: My hide is loose. It swings with each step.

lines.zh: 我朝味道最浓的地方走。
lines.en: I walk toward the strongest smell.

lines.zh: 这片地我熟，路都踏出来了。
lines.en: I know this land. I've worn the paths.
I don't travel in packs. Alone.
Three steps, then stop and listen.

lines.zh: 地上有草屑，我踩着不响。
lines.en: Grass husks underfoot. I step silently.

lines.zh: 我绕了一大圈，还是朝你。
lines.en: I went wide, but I'm still aimed at you.

lines.zh: 我在枯地中线上走，那样快。
lines.en: I walk the dead land's spine. Faster that way.

lines.zh: 走到这里，我已经很饿了。
lines.en: I've come this far. Very hungry.

lines.zh: 我身上没什么肉，就是这样。
lines.en: Not much meat on me. That's how it is.

lines.zh: 我一步步靠近，没有声音。
lines.en: Closer, step by step. No sound.

lines.zh: 我蹲着，脊背的骨看得见。
lines.en: I crouch. The bones of my back show.
Perfectly still. Saving strength.
I look up. The sky is grey.

lines.zh: 我的耳朵一直转，找声音。
lines.en: My ears keep turning for sound.

lines.zh: 这地方太干，我连口水都没有。
lines.en: So dry. I have no spit at all.
I lick a forepaw. Tastes of dirt.
Waiting. Starving. Standing.
Only me here. Better that way.
Insects moving in the soil. I hear them.

lines.zh: 我慢慢地吸气，肋骨张开。
lines.en: A slow breath. My ribs spread.
Wind passes. I don't flinch.

lines.zh: 我数着能听见的活物，只有一个。
lines.en: Living things I can hear: one.
Waiting for it to darken before I move.

lines.zh: 我抖掉背上的土，骨头跟着响。
lines.en: I shake the dust off my back and my bones rattle.

lines.zh: 喉咙里有一点声音，很轻。
lines.en: A small sound in my throat. Very faint.
It's not patience. It's no strength.
Sturdier than I expected.
Me looking at you. Measuring.

lines.zh: 我的肋骨一根根数得清。
lines.en: You can count my ribs one by one.
I tilt my head. My neck is too long.
You back up. I wait for more.
My eyes are deep in their sockets.

lines.zh: 你在看我的牙，那是对的。
lines.en: You're looking at my teeth. Correct.

lines.zh: 我把身体压低，好像要趴下。
lines.en: I flatten down. As if to lie.
I'm actually loading my legs.

lines.zh: 我盯你很久了，先动的人输。
lines.en: I've watched you long enough—whoever moves first loses.
These eyes have catalogued you.

lines.zh: 你伸来的手，我看着像肉。
lines.en: That hand you're reaching out looks like meat to me.
Two steps back. Unsteady.
My body sways at a touch.
Where you hit, it caved.
A tuft of fur came off.
I growl. My throat is dry.
I circle back. Quickly.
This pain pales next to hunger.
I braced on my forepaws. Didn't fall.
You broke up my pounce.

lines.zh: 我记住了你出手的节奏。
lines.en: I've learned the rhythm of your swings.
Meat. I smell raw meat.
Throw it closer. I'm too tired to walk.
I eat meat. Not plants.
Set it down. I'll count to three.

lines.zh: 那味道让我的胃抽了一下。
lines.en: That smell made my stomach clench.
Forward. Paw first.
Don't dangle it. I might miss and hit you.
Not enough. I've been hungry too long.

lines.zh: 我们这种，吃饱是不可能的。
lines.en: For us, full is impossible.

lines.zh: 你退开，我吃起来不好看。
lines.en: Step back. I'm ugly when I eat.

lines.zh: 腐的也吃，不过最好是新的。
lines.en: Rotten will do. Fresh is better.

lines.zh: 这块肉进了嘴，我就不松。
lines.en: Once this meat's in my mouth, I won't let go.
That smell means I can't slow down.

lines.zh: 你手再伸一点，我就够到了。
lines.en: A little further and I reach.

lines.zh: 我吃东西的时候会一直看着你。
lines.en: I'll keep watching you while I eat.
After this, I'll still be hungry.
You touched me and I nearly fell.
I back off. Legs unsteady.
This thin, a bump is nothing.

lines.zh: 你踩着我干瘦的爪子了。
lines.en: You're standing on my scrawny claw.
I go around. I turn fast.
Don't crowd. I'll bite.
That cost me a tuft of fur.
By your feet. Very light.
My spine scraped your hand.

lines.zh: 这一下让你知道我不大。
lines.en: Now you know I'm not big.
There are too few of us to meet.

lines.zh: 我这一生只见过一只同类。
lines.en: I've met one of my kind in my life.
If you were one of us, I'd scent first.
This land won't raise another litter.

lines.zh: 我只想吃饱，别的想不动。
lines.en: I only want to eat. Nothing else.

lines.zh: 我们这种不会靠近彼此。
lines.en: We don't come close to each other.
Back off. I'm covered in dirt.
Maybe when the rain comes.
I can't even keep myself.

lines.zh: 别学我的样子，你会饿死。
lines.en: Don't copy me. You'd starve.
I pick it up and shake it twice.
It doesn't bleed. Disappointing.
Sniff first. Then bite.
This is all there is. I'll take it.
Under my forepaw. Gnawing slowly.
Yours? Good. Mine now.
Can't chew it. I spat it out.
Not enough to line my stomach.
Carry it along. Saves energy.
This doesn't taste too bad.
I lifted my head. Rare.
You're ahead of me. Nothing else.

lines.zh: 我压低身子，后腿蹬住了。
lines.en: I flatten. Hind legs braced.
Only you here.
Both ears turned to you.

lines.zh: 我听见你踩断了一根枯枝。
lines.en: I heard a dry twig snap.

lines.zh: 你身上的热气，我隔着土都感觉得到。
lines.en: Your heat comes through the soil.
Locked on. No changing.
No need to run. I'm faster.

lines.zh: 这一带没有藏身的地方。
lines.en: Nowhere to hide in this area.
Step by step. Very quiet.
My shadow is shorter than yours.

lines.zh: 你退到枯地中心，那就没路了。
lines.en: Back to the middle of the dead land. No way out.
Counting how many steps you have left.
I've taken your flank.

lines.zh: 你呼吸变粗了，我听得到。
lines.en: Your breathing deepened. I hear it.
My hind legs won't stop trembling.

lines.zh: 这一片只有我一个人来。
lines.en: I'm the only one who comes here.

lines.zh: 你站的位置很好，对我而言。
lines.en: Good spot you've chosen. For me.
My paws are braced. Now.

lines.zh: 我扑上去，速度比自己想的快。
lines.en: I spring. Faster than I expected of myself.
Claws first. Then the mouth.

lines.zh: 你把我甩开，我落地滚了一圈。
lines.en: You threw me off. I landed rolling.

lines.zh: 我从背后咬住了你的腰带。
lines.en: From behind, teeth in your belt.

lines.zh: 你退了，我盯着你的喉咙。
lines.en: You retreated. I'm fixed on your throat.

lines.zh: 这一下,把枯草压平了一片。
lines.en: That flattened a patch of dead grass.
I shake my head and pull you off balance.

lines.zh: 我喘得像破风箱，爪子没停。
lines.en: I wheeze like a broken bellows, but my claws don't stop.

lines.zh: 这一击是最后一次冲刺。
lines.en: That was the last sprint I had.
Still standing. I'll try again.
I come in from the edge of the dead land.
Rare event: here I am.

lines.zh: 地上多了几道很细的爪印。
lines.en: A few very fine claw marks on the ground.

lines.zh: 风把我身上的土吹起来了。
lines.en: Wind lifts the dirt off me.

lines.zh: 我在枯草里伸了个懒腰。
lines.en: I stretch among the dead grass.

lines.zh: 这地方的味道，我闻着不错。
lines.en: The smell here suits me.
I came alone. No companions.
I stand in the middle of the dead plain. Thin.

lines.zh: 我出现的时候，没有声音。
lines.en: I arrived silently.

lines.zh: 这片原野上，很少见我这样的。
lines.en: Few like me on this field.
Fire. I run flat to the ground.
Fell. A paw folded wrong.

lines.zh: 我从没进过水，这很难受。
lines.en: Never been in water. This is awful.
Blown away. Landed far.

lines.zh: 饥饿原野里，鳞片是我的甲。
lines.en: In the starving fields, scales are my armor.
That light froze me stiff.

lines.zh: 饿到这一步，我连牙都合不拢。
lines.en: This hungry, I can't even close my teeth.

lines.zh: 雷劈在枯地上，我的毛全竖了。
lines.en: Lightning on dead ground. My fur stood up.

lines.zh: 往下掉，四只爪子都空着。
lines.en: Falling. All four paws empty.
